Our dietitians help people get relief from complex digestive concerns like diarrhea, constipation, persistent bloating, SIBO, acid reflux, allergy, EOE, and much more.

feeds.title: Know Your Gut Blog
feeds.description: I am Galina Kotlyar, MS RD LDN and I am both a clinician and a former IBD patient. I was diagnosed with an 'incurable' ulcerative pancolitis. I cured my 'incurable disease' through 30 years of continuous medical research, clinical work, and application of a Flare Stopper System. Today, I am on a mission to help people with IBD (ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease) to stop their flares and go into remission.
